description: This file implements a logr.Logger interface backed by Uber's Zap logging library, providing custom levels, field handling, and configuration options for logging within a Go project.

classes.name: zapLogger
classes.description: A struct implementing logr.Logger and logr.CallDepthLogSink, wrapping a zap.Logger with additional configuration for levels, fields, and error handling.

methods.name: handleFields
methods.description: Converts key-value pairs and zap.Fields into zap.Fields, injecting log level if configured.

methods.name: invokeMarshaler
methods.description: Safely marshals a logr.Marshaler, recovering from panics.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the zapLogger with runtime info, adjusting call depth.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Checks if a given log level is enabled.

methods.name: Info
methods.description: Logs an info message at a specified level with key-value pairs.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Logs an error message with an associated error object.

methods.name: WithValues
methods.description: Returns a new logger with additional key-value context.

methods.name: WithName
methods.description: Returns a new logger with a specified name.

methods.name: WithCallDepth
methods.description: Returns a new logger with adjusted call depth.
